usedFor: Kylas CRM holds leads, and “Lead Updated” keeps the matching contact in snapADDY current.

bestTemplate.name: “Lead Updated” in Kylas CRM, then “Update contact” in snapADDY
bestTemplate.why: Changes to a lead flow into the matching snapADDY contact, so both lists agree.

watchOut: “Update contact” in snapADDY edits an existing contact, so the person must already be on the selected list.
